SECTION 23 / OWASP REVISION
OWASP Top 10:2025 — revision
Paraphrased categories in the official 2025 order, with example defensive controls.

A01 — Access control failures
Enforce ownership and permissions server-side.

A02 — Insecure configuration
Use secure defaults and review deployment settings.

A03 — Supply-chain security
Review dependency provenance, scan and patch.

A04 — Cryptographic weaknesses
Choose suitable encryption and password hashing.

A05 — Injection
Separate code from data and safely render output.

A06 — Design weaknesses
Threat-model before coding.

A07 — Authentication weaknesses
Protect credentials, login and sessions.

A08 — Integrity failures
Verify signatures and trusted updates.

A09 — Logging and alerting gaps
Detect and respond without leaking secrets.

A10 — Unsafe exception handling
Fail safely and avoid revealing internal details.
Official reference: OWASP Top 10:2025. These labels are summarized, not official category wording.
